description: LibreLane Classic, synthesis step only (06-yosys-synthesis netlist)
options: LibreLane defaults; per-design config.json in the run directory

script:
read_verilog -sv <PATH>
synth -flatten -top <HOST> -run begin:fine
opt -full
opt_dff -sat
synth -top <HOST> -run fine:
opt_dff -sat
opt -full
dfflibmap -liberty <PATH>
abc -liberty <PATH>
opt_clean -purge
hilomap -hicell sky130_fd_sc_hd__conb_1 HI -locell sky130_fd_sc_hd__conb_1 LO
opt_clean -purge
write_verilog -noattr <PATH>

read_verilog -sv <PATH>
synth -flatten -top <HOST> -run begin:fine
opt -full
opt_dff -sat
synth -top <HOST> -run fine:
opt_dff -sat
opt -full
techmap
dfflibmap -liberty <PATH>
abc -liberty <PATH>
opt_clean -purge
hilomap -hicell sky130_fd_sc_hd__conb_1 HI -locell sky130_fd_sc_hd__conb_1 LO
opt_clean -purge
write_verilog -noattr <PATH>

read_verilog -sv <PATH>
synth -flatten -top <HOST> -run begin:fine
opt -full
opt_dff -sat
synth -top <HOST> -run fine:
opt_dff -sat
opt -full
async2sync
dfflegalize -cell $_DFF_P_ 01
abc -dff -script +strash;scorr;dc2;strash
techmap
opt -fast
opt_clean -purge
dfflibmap -liberty <PATH>
abc -liberty <PATH>
opt_clean -purge
hilomap -hicell sky130_fd_sc_hd__conb_1 HI -locell sky130_fd_sc_hd__conb_1 LO
opt_clean -purge
write_verilog -noattr <PATH>
